title: Llama Windows App from Hugging Face Brings One-Click Local AI to Windows 11
key_facts: Hugging Face released Llama Windows, a free, open-source desktop app for Windows 11.
It brings the llama.cpp local AI engine to Windows, similar to an existing Mac app.
Users pick a model from the Hugging Face Hub, download it in one click and run it from the notification area; no terminal, build step or admin rights needed.
Native support for Windows 11 on Arm and Nvidia's new RTX Spark platform at launch.
The app recommends models suited to the PC's hardware.
It is a native WinUI3 app with an Alt + Space assistant window.
quote_evidence: With Llama Windows, you can pick a model from the Hugging Face Hub, download it in one click, and run it locally from the notification area.
No terminal, no build step, no admin rights.
Llama Windows is a free, open source desktop app that brings the llama.cpp local AI inferencing library to Windows 11.
why_it_matters_hint: Removes the technical setup that makes local AI hard on Windows.
